items.title: Jensen Huang is ‘too big to fire,’ putting Nvidia’s governance in focus: analysts
items.title_zh: 分析师认为，Jensen Huang“功高盖主”，Nvidia的治理问题备受关注
items.summary: Jensen Huang’s return has underscored Nvidia’s deep reliance on its founder, putting the company's board oversight and corporate governance under scrutiny.
items.summary_zh: 黄仁勋的回归凸显了英伟达对其创始人的深度依赖，使公司的董事会监督和公司治理受到严密审视。

items.title: Love Blooms Behind an Open Prison’s Missing Bars in Venice and Busan-Selected Director Nidhi Saxena’s ‘Azaad Nagar’ at WAVES Film Bazaar
items.title_zh: 在威尼斯和釜山入选的导演Nidhi Saxena的《Azaad Nagar》中，爱情在没有铁栏的开放式监狱中绽放——WAVES电影市场
items.summary: Nidhi Saxena, whose films have premiered at Busan and Venice, is presenting “Azaad Nagar” (Redemption Road), a Hindi-language love story set inside an Indian open prison, at the Co-Production Market at WAVES Film Bazaar.
items.summary_zh: Nidhi Saxena的电影曾在釜山和威尼斯首映，她将在WAVES电影市场（WAVES Film Bazaar）的联合制作市场（Co-Production Market）上展示《Azaad Nagar》（《救赎之路》），这是一部以印度开放式监狱为背景的印地语爱情片。

items.title: Ranbir Kapoor’s ‘Brahmastra’ Sequel Could Go ‘Even More Indian,’ Director Ayan Mukerji Tells IFFI
items.title_zh: 导演阿亚·穆克吉在印度国际电影节上表示，兰比尔·卡普尔主演的《勇士》续集可能会“更具印度特色”
items.summary: Ayan Mukerji, director of the Ranbir Kapoor-starring fantasy epic “Brahmastra: Part One – Shiva,” told audiences at the 57th International Film Festival of India (IFFI) in Goa that his next creative focus is the sequel, “Brahmastra 2.” “I hope that…
items.summary_zh: 由兰比尔·卡普尔主演的奇幻史诗电影《烈焰神驹：第一部——湿婆》的导演阿扬·穆克吉在果阿举行的第57届印度国际电影节（IFFI）上告诉观众，他的下一个创作重点是续集《烈焰神驹2》。他说：“我希望……

items.title: Thomasina Miers’ recipe for fried fish with red pipián, and celeriac and leek rice
items.title_zh: Thomasina Miers的炸鱼配红皮皮安酱、芹菜根和韭葱饭食谱
items.summary: Packed with flavour and natural goodness, spicy Mexican pipián sauce goes brilliantly with white fish, while a garlicky vegetable rice is perfect on the side As the weather closes in, I find my cooking naturally moving towards comfort as well as goodness.
items.summary_zh: 墨西哥皮皮安辣酱风味浓郁，天然健康，与白鱼完美搭配，而蒜香蔬菜饭则是绝佳的配菜。随着天气转凉，我发现自己的烹饪自然而然地转向了温馨和健康。

items.title: AI adoption grows in Asia, but measuring the gains remains tricky
items.title_zh: 亚洲的人工智能应用日益普及，但衡量其收益仍然很棘手
items.summary: Businesses across Asia-Pacific are seeing returns from AI investments, even as confidence in measuring those gains varies, according to an AWS survey.
items.summary_zh: 根据 AWS 的一项调查，尽管对衡量这些收益的信心各不相同，但亚太地区的企业正在从人工智能投资中获得回报。

items.title: Iran says three tankers hit mines in Hormuz despite U.S. escort, as Treasury widens sanctions
items.title_zh: 伊朗称，尽管有美国护航，但仍有三艘油轮在霍尔木兹海峡触雷，与此同时，美国财政部扩大了制裁范围。
items.summary: Iran said three oil tankers caught fire after hitting naval mines in the Strait of Hormuz, as the U.S. escalates sanctions aimed at cutting off Tehran's financial lifelines.
items.summary_zh: 伊朗表示，在三艘油轮触碰霍尔木兹海峡的海军水雷后起火，与此同时，美国正在加紧实施旨在切断德黑兰经济命脉的制裁。

items.title: Google alternative Kagi launches an email service
items.title_zh: Google 替代搜索引擎 Kagi 推出了电子邮件服务
items.summary: Kagi, which already offers a paid alternative to Google Search and its own Orion browser as a rival to Chrome, is taking on another Google service: Gmail.
items.summary_zh: Kagi已经提供了一个付费的Google搜索替代方案，以及自己的Orion浏览器作为Chrome的竞争对手，现在又将瞄准Google的另一项服务：Gmail。

items.title: Figma employee sues, alleging company forced her to confront harassers
items.title_zh: Figma 员工提起诉讼，指控公司迫使她与骚扰者对峙
items.summary: Figma and its CEO are being sued by a current employee for alleged sexual harassment and discrimination.
items.summary_zh: Figma及其首席执行官正因涉嫌性骚扰和歧视而被一名现任员工起诉。

items.title: Anthropic launches Claude Ship, letting AI agents review, fix, and approve code changes
items.title_zh: Anthropic推出Claude Ship，让AI代理审查、修复和批准代码变更
items.summary: As AI-generated code piles up, Anthropic's new developer tools aim to eliminate another bottleneck by letting agents handle routine approvals.
items.summary_zh: 随着人工智能生成的代码不断累积，Anthropic 的新开发者工具旨在通过让代理处理日常审批来消除另一个瓶颈。
